settings.heading: Color, Material & Meaning
settings.text:
Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water offer a way to explore color, texture and the rhythms of nature.

Our Five Elements jewelry draws on Eastern philosophy as design inspiration. Choose a piece for its natural materials, the colors you are drawn to and the meaning you bring to it.
settings.image_alt: Pearl and purple gemstone earrings from the supplied Five Elements image.

settings.heading: Objects for Stillness & Intention
settings.text:
Natural beads carry the traces of the material and the hands that work with it. Wood, jade and gemstones offer different textures, colors and rhythms.

This collection explores their place in contemplative traditions and the personal meaning of objects we choose to keep close.
settings.image_alt: A quiet moment working with natural beads, from the supplied lifestyle imagery.
Jewelry — Handcrafted jewelry inspired by natural stones and timeless details. A natural stone pendant necklace on warm linen.
